# fluss-go v0.2.0-beta.3

This maintenance beta keeps the fluss-go v0.2 client aligned with patched Go
and dependency releases for Apache Fluss 1.0. It changes no exported API or
Fluss wire behavior.

## Upgrade

- Apache Fluss 0.9.1 users must remain on fluss-go `v0.1.0-beta.11`.
- Go 1.26.11 is required; Go 1.25 is no longer supported.
- Keep the root module and any HDFS, OSS, OpenTelemetry, or S3 adapter module
  on the same `v0.2.0-beta.3` release.
- Review the [v0.2 migration guide](https://github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/blob/v0.2.0-beta.3/docs/migration-v0.2.md#upgrading-from-v020-beta2)
  before rollout.

```sh
go get github.com/pletorco/fluss-go@v0.2.0-beta.3
go get github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/adapters/s3@v0.2.0-beta.3
go mod tidy
```

## Highlights

- Updates `github.com/klauspost/compress` to 1.20.2 in every module to fix
  `CVE-2026-116591` (`GO-2026-6865`).
- Requires Go 1.26.11, including the standard-library fixes for
  `CVE-2026-111943` (`GO-2026-6809`) and `CVE-2026-97031` (`GO-2026-6607`).
- Updates Goldmark to 1.8.7, Alibaba Cloud OSS SDK to 1.6.1, OpenTelemetry to
  1.47.0, AWS SDK core to 1.48.0, and AWS S3 to 1.114.10.
- Consolidates Dependabot Go updates at the workspace root and groups related
  AWS SDK and OpenTelemetry modules so future update pull requests are not
  duplicated per adapter.

The exact supported surface and live proof remain documented in the
[Fluss 1.0 feature matrix](https://github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/blob/v0.2.0-beta.3/README.md#fluss-10-feature-matrix)
and [live evidence matrix](https://github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/blob/v0.2.0-beta.3/docs/live-evidence.md).

## Deliberate boundaries

Historical physical-partition routing for lake workflows remains unsupported,
and native Iceberg, Lance, and Paimon planning remains application-owned. This
release is still a pure-Go client and does not link or wrap the Fluss Rust
core.

## Verification

The release candidate is validated with unit, golden, fuzz-smoke, race,
generation, API, documentation, security, storage-adapter, and live Fluss 1.0
checks. The live suite uses Apache Fluss 1.0.0 commit
`5c07f88e50a8ff41b0ebc214a0458e5dba60be37` and image digest
`sha256:ff461b45438033da4fd1c2556d3f978f3603bb3632fe075c2bd57388339a58cb`.

No release tag should be created until the release-preparation pull request is
approved and merged.
